description: One published note in full: its text as written, the day it was published, its address on the site, and every link it cites. Takes the slug from list_notes or search_notes, or the last part of a note's own URL.

slug.description: The note's slug, for example "2026-10-28-a-note-title-1a2b3c4d". A full /intel/... path works too.

name: get_note
title: Read one published note
